# 🎁  Mega ECR × Playoff Guide!

# ✦・━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━・✦

## INGRID MEGA ECR  🔥

 Hold up! Don't spin! Read below carefully!

 There are two approaches depending on whether you already own Ingrid Pilot.

## If you already own Ingrid:

- Avoid playing matches to prevent progressing through Phase 1 of Playoff.

- Complete non-gameplay Accolade Challenge quests to collect Mega ECR tokens.

-# Eg: Scrap 3 Implants.

- Save your tokens till one day before playoff ends.

- Spin your saved Mega ECR tokens **BEFORE THE ARENA PLAYOFF ENDS!**

- Each ECR spin gives 50 Playoff Points. 70 spins = 3,500 Playoff Points!

Note: If you follow this strategy, you can't get all the 70 tokens, but still 500 A-coins from ECR < Upto 3,000 A-coins from Playoff.

## If you don't own Ingrid:

- Don't worry about delaying your Arena Playoff progression.

- Ingrid is also available through the 120th-day daily login reward.

My recommendation: A free pilot + 2,500 A-Coins is more valuable than competing for just 3,000 A-Coins in the Playoff.
